name: No UBO identification procedure
description: No documented process for unwinding ownership to natural persons.

name: No PEP / sanctions screening
description: Counterparties not screened against PEP / sanctions / adverse-media lists.

name: Sanctions / PEP lists out of date
description: Lists relied on are weeks or months old.

name: No cash-handling policy / threshold
description: Staff have no documented threshold or escalation rule for cash.

name: No record-keeping cycle
description: Records not retained for the regulatory minimum (typically 5 years).

name: No STR / SAR pathway
description: No documented pathway from suspicion to FIU / NCA filing.

name: No baseline staff / owner training
description: Staff and owner have no documented FCP awareness training.

name: No named compliance responsibility
description: No-one is accountable for FCP — even on a part-time / owner-wears-it basis.
